notes: Portable Dimension-table description preflight through official Federation Create and dimension lookup services. The adapter supplies the provider package, standard MIM, seven schema-valid FOM bindings, endpoint, logical time, and callback model. It preserves the empty-input-type/NA and meaningful-description cases, named HLAcount with NA or amplifying text, and three separately isolated blank required text cells (inputDataDescription, normalization, outputDataSemantics) rejected through public Create as InconsistentFOM. The rebuilt installed MinGW C++ package passed the focused 24/24 CTest dimension regression across 12 scenario IDs and direct runs in both callback models. An earlier packaged JNI Java run remains historical evidence for the description paths only; no Java rerun, interoperability, or provider conformance is claimed.
